policy: On the full36-coordinate proton field space, start from the existing12 edge-occurrence tangent rows H and actual order-three source sector permutation R. Compute the exact rational row span of H, H R and H R^2, retaining patch supports.
tests: Exact RREF with row-combination certificate both ways
Derived output action K with O R = K O and K^3 = I
Recovery of H and all orbit rows from O
Explicit nullspace basis and rotation invariance
boundary: Minimality is among linear observation row spaces containing H and closed under the specified action. It is not a lower bound on arbitrary nonlinear encodings or proof of geometric vertex transport. Additional covectors are not relabelled as the original scalar edge traces.
stop_condition: Certified exact dimension, output action, original-trace decoder and lost-field basis, or first failed identity.
